title: Dashboard shows total and status counters on initial load
description: Verifies the dashboard loads and displays the key counters for total processes and per-status counts.

steps.description: Verify a numeric value for the total processes counter is visible

title: Doughnut status chart is visible and renders status legend/labels
description: Verifies the doughnut chart for process statuses is present and appears rendered with visible status labels/legend.

title: Bar chart for process locations is visible and renders location labels
description: Verifies the bar chart for process locations is present and appears rendered with visible location labels.

steps.description: Verify element "Bar chart axes" is visible
Verify element "At least one bar in the bar chart" is visible

title: Filter main table by clicking the 'Em Tramitação' dashboard card
description: Verifies clicking the 'Em Tramitação' card filters the main table to show only processes in that status.

steps.description: Verify element "Em Tramitação dashboard card" is visible
Verify element "Main processes table" is visible
Verify that a status indicator "Em Tramitação" is visible in at least one table row

title: Open 'Editar Processo' modal from a filtered table row
description: Verifies that after filtering to 'Em Tramitação', clicking a table row opens the 'Editar Processo' modal with process details.

steps.description: Verify element "Main processes table" is visible
Click on the first row in the main processes table
Verify element "Process details section in the modal" is visible

title: Dashboard charts show an empty/error state when data cannot be loaded
description: Verifies that when chart data cannot be loaded, the UI shows a visible empty/error message with guidance to retry or check connection.

steps.description: Wait for element "Doughnut chart" to appear
Verify that either text "Erro" is visible or text "Sem dados" is visible
Verify text "Tentar novamente" is visible or Verify text "Verifique a conexão" is visible
Verify element "Bar chart" is visible or Verify that an empty/error message near the bar chart is visible

title: Search for an existing process by number and edit supplier (Fornecedor) successfully
description: Verifies a user can search for a process, open edit modal, update Fornecedor, and see confirmation plus updated value.

steps.description: Click on the process row that contains text "12345"
Verify element "Editar Processo" modal is visible
Verify a success notification is visible

title: Search for a non-existent process number shows 'No processes found'
description: Verifies searching for an unknown process number returns an empty state message.

steps.description: Verify text "No processes found" is visible

title: Create a new process successfully from 'Novo Processo' modal
description: Verifies a user can open the create modal, fill required fields, submit, and see success confirmation.

steps.description: Verify element "Novo Processo" modal is visible
Type "1000" into the "Valor da Capa" field
Type "2026-03-13" into the "Data de Abertura" field
Verify a success notification is visible

title: Create process validation: missing Fornecedor shows required-field error
description: Verifies the create form blocks submission and displays a validation message when Fornecedor is empty.

steps.description: Verify element "Novo Processo" modal is visible
Type "1000" into the "Valor da Capa" field
Type "2026-03-13" into the "Data de Abertura" field

title: Filter by Status and Location and view process timeline entries
description: Verifies filtering updates the table and the history modal displays timeline entries for a selected process.

steps.description: Select an option from the Status filter dropdown
Select an option from the Location filter dropdown
Click on the first process row in the filtered results
Click on the "Histórico de Processo" button
Verify element "Histórico de Processo" modal is visible
Verify element "timeline" entries list is visible

title: History modal shows empty state when there are no history entries
description: Verifies the history modal provides a clear message when a process has no timeline/history entries.

steps.description: Click on a process row expected to have no history entries
Click on the "Histórico de Processo" button
Verify element "Histórico de Processo" modal is visible
Verify text "No history entries" is visible
